title: GovAGI
tagline: GovAGI empowers a community of prompt and question validators, ensuring that the content fed into AGIs is democratically approved and ethically sound.
description:
In the rapidly evolving landscape of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), GovAGI emerges as a pioneering solution, introducing a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) to oversee the governance of AGI interactions. This platform is designed to empower a community of prompt and question validators, ensuring that the content fed into AGIs is democratically approved and ethically sound.

We want to prevent the misuse and centralization of how AGI evolves.

Our primary goal is to establish a transparent, community-driven framework for AGI governance. By integrating the DAO mechanism and the principles of collective decision-making, GovAGI aims to address the ethical and practical challenges of AGI interactions, promoting responsible and beneficial use.
